Definition: A unique alphanumeric identifier for this learning opportunity that is used for your customers or for internal processes within your system.
CTDL Transformation Notes: Published as a ceterms:IdentifierValue with Identifier Type Name "External Identifier" and the supplied value as its Identifier Value Code.

Definition: Name or title of the resource.
Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
CTDL Transformation Notes: Must be a minimum of 15 characters.
Sample: This course guides students in the development of...

Definition: Webpage that describes this entity.
CTDL Transformation Notes: Must be a properly formatted URL beginning in https://

Definition: Type of state of the resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle; select from an enumeration of such types.
Extraction Notes: For the initial upload, this would typically be "Active"
CTDL Transformation Notes: This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select one of the defined values.
Controlled Vocabulary:
Active
Ceased
Ceasing
Developing
Suspended
Teach Out

Definition: The primary language or languages of the entity, even if it makes use of other languages.
Extraction Notes: Must be a known language name. If no language is provided, the value will default to English.
CTDL Transformation Notes: If there are multiple languages, use a pipe-separated (|) list.

Definition: An inventory or listing of resources that includes this resource.
Extraction Notes: Use this property instead of ceterms:subjectWebpage if the source of the course information is a defined catalog.
CTDL Transformation Notes: Must be a properly formatted URL beginning in https://

Definition: A credit-related value.
Extraction Notes:
This property uses the value ceterms:ValueProfile.

Enter the number of credit units awarded for college credit or continuing education units for successful completion of the learning opportunity.

Definition: The value of the property value node.
Extraction Notes: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

Definition: The lower value of some characteristic or property.
Extraction Notes: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

Definition: The upper value of some characteristic or property.
Extraction Notes: In CTDL: for single values, use schema:value; for ranges, use schema:minValue and schema:maxValue.

Definition: Resource carries or confers no official academic credit according to the provider of the resource.
Extraction Notes: If the learning opportunity is non-credit, enter the value TRUE. Otherwise, leave blank.

Definition: Date after which this resource is available or applicable.
Extraction Notes: Values should be a full date, i.e. year, month and day; if the day or month are not known use ceterms:approximateDateEffective instead.
CTDL Transformation Notes: Must be a valid date using YYYY/MM/DD or MM/DD/YYYY format. Can also use a hyphen for separator (YYYY-MM-DD).

Definition: Approximate date after which this resource is available or applicable.
Extraction Notes: Values may be just a year (e.g. 2026) or a year and a month (e.g. (2026-05). If the full date, i.e. year, month and day, are known use ceterms:dateEffective.
CTDL Transformation Notes: The value should be in ISO 8601 date format; specifically YYYY or YYY-MM.

CTDL Transformation Notes: This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select from the list of defined values. For multiple, separate with pipes (|).

Extraction Notes: Use this property if the delivery type described for the course does not match one of the controlled variables in ceterms:deliveryType. The value should be the verbatim text of the delivery type.

Definition: Description of the methods used to conduct learning.
Extraction Notes: Use this property if the learning method described for the course does not match one of the controlled variables in ceterms:learningMethodDescription. The value should be the verbatim text of the learning method.
Sample: This program includes experiential and project-based learning methods.

Definition: Description of the topics, concepts, theories, and practices addressed by a learning opportunity, program, course or assessment.
Sample: Topics covered are mechanical waves, sound, electrostatics, current and DC circuits, magnetism, light and optics, and modern physics.

Definition: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.

Requirements for entry into a credentialing program, a learning opportunity, or an assessment, including credentials, transcripts, records of previous experience, or other forms of entry documentation.
Extraction Notes:
ceterms:entryCondition has a value of Condition Profile and uses the properties associated with Condition Profile.

Use this property for requirements for entry, enrollment, or participation in a Course that are not Prerequisites, Corequisites, Co-Prerequisites, or recommendations.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Extraction Notes: Use this property for the verbatim textual information that is specified in the Entry Condition.
Sample: Students who earn a grade point average of 3.0 or higher are eligible to apply.

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Extraction Notes: Use this property to list the specific course objects that are included in the Entry Condition, using External Identifier(s) as the value(s).

Definition: Estimated time it will take to complete an activity, event, or resource.
Extraction Notes:
Use this property to describe time-based values using the subclass ceterms:DurationProfile.

ceterms:DurationProfile is defined as: Entity describing the temporal aspects of a resource. Temporal aspects include exact, minimum, and maximum timeframes of an activity.

A resource may list multiple time-based values, in which case there should be multiple Duration Profiles.

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Extraction Notes: Use this property for the verbatim textual description of the time-based values.

Definition: Overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Extraction Notes: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
CTDL Transformation Notes: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 6 months as P6M.

Definition: Minimum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Extraction Notes: This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.
CTDL Transformation Notes: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 3 months as P3M.

Definition: Maximum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Extraction Notes:
This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.

Do not use ceterms:maximumDuration to identify the renewal frequency of a credential; use ceterms:renewalFrequency instead.
CTDL Transformation Notes: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 9 months as P9M.

Definition: Total engaged or participating time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Extraction Notes: This is intended to indicate only the sum of the individual amounts of time which are spent actively engaged in pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource, regardless of the overall time span required to complete it.
CTDL Transformation Notes: If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 50 hours as PT50H.
